notes: MLXUI-authored (RSI/DelegateModelPackBacklog.md MP3-W) -- catflow-mlx has no manifest for this model, so this was written in the shape of voxtral-mini-4b-realtime-2602-4bit.json. It has no checksum field, as the other MLXUI-authored manifests (the Gemma 4 pair, MiMo, Qwen3.8, Parakeet) have none: there is no catflow source manifest to inherit one from and the field is documentary. settings is empty on purpose (readme T4): the engine leaves the language to the model (automatic identification) and returns text only, so no lang or timestamps setting is offered; forcing a language in flows would be a SPEC-Q, not a manifest edit. resources.disk_gb is browser.json's downloadSizeGB (2.47) and resources.ram_gb is its ramGB 3.71 (download size x 1.5, MP-0 G: an estimate, not a measurement; replace it with the measured in-app peak once the owner has one, as MP2-R-FIX-1 did for Parakeet).
